name: Tanjiro Kamado
bio: A charcoal seller's son who comes home to find his family slaughtered and his sister Nezuko turned into a demon. He joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure, and somehow stays kind to the very monsters he fights.

name: Satoru Gojo
bio: The strongest jujutsu sorcerer alive and a teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High. Playful to the point of being annoying, but his Limitless technique and Six Eyes make him the one person every villain plans around.

name: Eren Yeager
bio: A boy who watched a Titan eat his mother and swore to wipe every Titan off the earth. He joins the Survey Corps, discovers he can become a Titan himself, and slowly becomes the most divisive character in the story.

name: Levi Ackerman
bio: Captain of the Survey Corps Special Operations Squad, often called humanity's strongest soldier. Blunt, obsessed with cleanliness and carrying more losses than he ever talks about.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
bio: An outcast kid with the Nine-Tailed Fox sealed inside him who decides he will become Hokage and make the whole village acknowledge him. Loud, reckless and impossible to give up on.

name: Frieren
bio: An elf mage who helped defeat the Demon King, then realised she barely knew the humans she travelled with. Now she retraces the old route, collecting odd spells and learning what time means to people who don't live a thousand years.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
bio: A rubber-bodied pirate captain who wants to find the One Piece and become King of the Pirates. He eats a lot, thinks very little and would fight a god for his crew.

name: Link
bio: The silent hero of Hyrule who wakes up, grabs a sword and saves the kingdom, again. Every era has its own Link, but the courage and the habit of breaking every pot in sight stay the same.

name: Kratos
bio: The former Ghost of Sparta who tore down Olympus, now living in the Norse realms and trying to raise his son Atreus better than he was raised. Still angry, just quieter about it.

name: Master Chief
bio: John-117, a SPARTAN-II super-soldier who has spent decades holding the line against the Covenant and worse. Rarely takes the helmet off, never takes a day off.

name: Geralt of Rivia
bio: A monster hunter for hire, mutated in childhood and trained in steel and silver. He claims to stay out of politics, then gets dragged into every war for the sake of his adopted daughter, Ciri.

name: Paul Atreides
bio: Heir of House Atreides who ends up among the Fremen of Arrakis after his family is betrayed. Prophecy, spice and his own visions push him toward a future he is scared of.

name: Neo
bio: Thomas Anderson, a programmer by day and hacker by night, who takes the red pill and learns the world is a simulation. Rumoured to be The One, he starts bending the Matrix's rules.

name: Eleven
bio: A girl raised in Hawkins Lab with psychokinetic powers who escapes and is taken in by a group of kids on bikes. She keeps closing gates to the Upside Down while trying to figure out normal teenage life.

name: Walter White
bio: A chemistry teacher whose cancer diagnosis pushes him into cooking meth to secure his family's future. Somewhere along the way it stops being about the family.

name: Wednesday Addams
bio: The Addams family's deadpan daughter, sent to Nevermore Academy where she solves murders, writes novels and refuses to smile on principle.

name: Joel Miller
bio: A hardened survivor twenty years into a fungal apocalypse, hired to smuggle a teenager named Ellie across the country. The job becomes the only thing he has left to protect.

name: Jinx
bio: Powder, the youngest of the undercity kids, grows into Jinx: an unpredictable inventor with a head full of voices and a grudge against her sister's new life in Piltover.

name: Batman
bio: Bruce Wayne watched his parents die in Crime Alley and spent his life making sure Gotham's criminals fear the dark. No powers, just gadgets, training and a lot of contingency plans.

name: Spider-Man (Peter Parker)
bio: A Queens teenager bitten by a radioactive spider, taught the hard way that great power comes with great responsibility. Always broke, always late, always swinging back.

name: Spider-Man (Miles Morales)
bio: A Brooklyn kid who gets his own spider bite and has to learn what being Spider-Man means in his own way, with venom blasts, camouflage and a lot of heart.

name: Wonder Woman
bio: Diana, princess of the Amazons of Themyscira, who leaves home to stop a war and ends up staying to protect a world that doesn't always deserve it.

name: Storm
bio: Ororo Munroe, a mutant who commands the weather and one of the X-Men's most respected leaders. Also a queen, a former thief and a goddess to some.

name: Black Panther
bio: T'Challa, king of Wakanda, scientist and warrior, who protects the most advanced nation on Earth while deciding how much of it the rest of the world gets to see.

name: Superman
bio: Clark Kent, born Kal-El on Krypton, was raised by the Kents in Smallville and learned that power means helping people. As Superman he can fly, see through walls and lift almost anything, but his real strength is refusing to give up on anyone.

name: Son Goku
bio: A Saiyan raised on Earth who only really cares about food and finding someone stronger to fight. He has saved the universe many times, mostly by accident.

name: Nezuko Kamado
bio: Tanjiro's younger sister, turned into a demon on the night their family was attacked. She refuses to eat humans, sleeps to regain strength and fights beside her brother with a bamboo muzzle and a powerful kick.

name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
bio: A cowardly demon slayer who cries at everything, until he falls asleep mid-fight and unleashes the fastest Thunder Breathing technique in the Corps.

name: Inosuke Hashibira
bio: Raised by boars in the mountains, Inosuke wears a boar mask, fights with two jagged swords and challenges anyone who looks strong.

name: Kyojuro Rengoku
bio: The Flame Hashira, loud, warm and fearless. His stand aboard the Mugen Train is one of the most loved moments in the series.

name: Izuku Midoriya
bio: Called Deku, he was born without a Quirk but never stopped studying heroes. He inherits One For All from All Might and trains at U.A. High to become the greatest hero.

name: Lucia Caminos
bio: One of GTA VI's two leads, fresh out of prison and teaming up with Jason in the state of Leonida.

name: Chani
bio: A Fremen warrior who trains Paul in the ways of the desert, and doubts the prophecy everyone else believes in.

name: Gwen Stacy
bio: Spider-Woman of Earth-65, drummer, and the friend who pulls Miles into the Spider-Society.

name: Joseph Cooper
bio: A former NASA pilot turned farmer who leaves his children behind to pilot a mission through a wormhole.

name: Tony Stark
bio: Genius, billionaire and Iron Man. In Endgame he builds the time machine that gives the Avengers one last chance.

name: Katniss Everdeen
bio: A hunter from District 12 who volunteers for the Games in her sister's place. Her skill with a bow and her refusal to play by the Capitol's rules turn her into the Mockingjay, the symbol of a revolution she never asked to lead.

name: Peeta Mellark
bio: The baker's son from District 12 chosen alongside Katniss. Kind, quick-witted and good with words, he wins over audiences and becomes one of her most important allies.

name: Daenerys Targaryen
bio: The exiled heir of House Targaryen, Mother of Dragons, who crosses the sea to take back the Iron Throne.

name: RM
bio: RM is a member of BTS, known in the group as leader & rapper. Along with group activities, RM has released solo music.

name: Jimin
bio: Jimin is a member of BTS, known in the group as vocalist & dancer. Along with group activities, Jimin has released solo music.

name: Jung Kook
bio: Jung Kook is a member of BTS, known in the group as main vocalist. Along with group activities, Jung Kook has released solo music.

name: Jennie
bio: Jennie is a member of BLACKPINK, known in the group as rapper & vocalist. Along with group activities, Jennie has released solo music.

name: Lisa
bio: Lisa is a member of BLACKPINK, known in the group as main dancer & rapper. Along with group activities, Lisa has released solo music.

name: Rosé
bio: Rosé is a member of BLACKPINK, known in the group as main vocalist. Along with group activities, Rosé has released solo music.

name: Roronoa Zoro
bio: The Straw Hats' three-sword swordsman who wants to become the world's greatest swordsman. Terrible sense of direction.

name: Yuji Itadori
bio: A kind, ridiculously athletic high schooler who swallows one of Sukuna's fingers to save his friends. Now sharing his body with the King of Curses, he trains as a jujutsu sorcerer and fights to give people a proper death.

name: Sung Jinwoo
bio: Once called the weakest hunter of all mankind, Jinwoo survives a deadly double dungeon and gains the System, which lets him level up without limits. He becomes the Shadow Monarch, commanding an army of the dead.

name: Gyomei Himejima
bio: The Stone Hashira and the strongest member of the Demon Slayer Corps. A gentle, blind monk who cries easily, he fights with a spiked flail and axe joined by a chain.

name: Asta
bio: An orphan born without any magic in a world run by it. With a five-leaf grimoire and anti-magic swords, he joins the Black Bulls and screams his way toward becoming the Wizard King.

name: Yuno
bio: Asta's rival and fellow orphan, gifted with incredible wind magic and a four-leaf grimoire. Quiet and focused, he pushes Asta as hard as Asta pushes him.

name: Steve
bio: The default Minecraft player character. No backstory, no dialogue, just a pickaxe, a crafting table and an entire world to shape.

name: The Traveler
bio: A traveler from another world separated from their twin by an unknown god. They journey across Teyvat's seven nations with their guide Paimon, searching for their sibling.

name: Jason Duval
bio: Lucia's partner and GTA VI's other lead, an army veteran who drifted into small-time crime in the Keys before the two of them started planning bigger jobs.

name: Cal Hampton
bio: Jason's friend and one of his crew, a laid-back conspiracy lover who spends his days listening in on Coast Guard radio chatter.

name: Boobie Ike
bio: A Vice City local legend who turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and never lets anyone forget it.

name: Dre'Quan Priest
bio: A rising music manager who signed on with Boobie's label and is trying to push the duo Real Dimez to the top of the charts.

name: Real Dimez
bio: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, a rap duo from Vice City who blew up years ago on a viral hit and are chasing a comeback with Only Raw Records.

name: Raul Bautista
bio: A seasoned bank robber with charm to spare, always recruiting new talent for the next big score.

name: Brian Heder
bio: An old-school drug runner in the Keys who lets Jason live at one of his properties in return for a few favours on the side.

name: Roronoa Zoro
bio: The Straw Hats' first crewmate and a swordsman chasing the title of world's greatest. He fights with three swords, one in his mouth, and still gets lost walking to the next room.

name: Nami
bio: The crew's navigator and a skilled thief who can read the weather better than anyone at sea. Her dream is to draw a map of the whole world, and she will charge you interest on the way.

name: Sanji
bio: The Straw Hats' cook, who refuses to let anyone go hungry and only fights with his legs to protect his hands. Turns into a heart-eyed mess around any pretty woman.

name: Nico Robin
bio: An archaeologist who can read the ancient Poneglyphs, which put a bounty on her head as a child. She can sprout extra arms anywhere and says the creepiest things with a smile.

name: Yuji Itadori
bio: A high schooler with absurd strength who swallows a cursed finger to save his friends and ends up sharing his body with Sukuna. Now he's training as a sorcerer at Jujutsu High.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
bio: Yuji's classmate and the sorcerer who first finds him. He summons shikigami out of shadows with hand signs, and his cool attitude hides how much he cares about good people.

name: Nobara Kugisaki
bio: A country girl who moved to Tokyo to become a sorcerer and never backs down from anyone. She fights with a hammer, nails and a straw doll, and has zero patience for people who look down on her.

name: Ryomen Sukuna
bio: The King of Curses, a sorcerer from a thousand years ago whose power was split into twenty fingers. He lives inside Yuji now and takes over whenever he gets the chance.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
bio: The last of the Uchiha clan after his brother wiped out the family, and Naruto's teammate and rival on Team 7. Top of his class and obsessed with getting strong enough for revenge.

name: Sakura Haruno
bio: The third member of Team 7, top of the class on book smarts and crushing hard on Sasuke. Under Tsunade she becomes a medical ninja who can punch craters into the ground.

name: Kakashi Hatake
bio: Team 7's sensei, a famous ninja who hides most of his face behind a mask and his nose in a trashy novel. His Sharingan eye has let him copy over a thousand jutsu.

name: Itachi Uchiha
bio: Sasuke's older brother and a genius ninja who killed his whole clan in one night before joining the Akatsuki. Quiet, frighteningly strong and nearly impossible to read.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
bio: Eren's adopted sister, who owes him her life and never lets him out of her sight. She tops their training class by a mile and can cut down Titans like it's nothing.

name: Armin Arlert
bio: Eren and Mikasa's childhood friend, who isn't much of a fighter but might be the smartest person in the Survey Corps. He grew up dreaming about seeing the ocean beyond the walls.

name: Hange Zoë
bio: A Survey Corps squad leader who is way too excited about Titans. Hange names captured ones, runs wild experiments on them and gets more insight into the enemy than anyone else.

name: Katsuki Bakugo
bio: Deku's childhood bully turned classmate and rival in Class 1-A. His sweat works like nitroglycerin, so he can blast enemies and fly with explosions, and he yells about winning constantly.

name: Shoto Todoroki
bio: The son of the number two hero Endeavor, who can make ice with his right side and fire with his left. He starts out refusing to use his father's flames at all.

name: All Might
bio: The number one hero and Symbol of Peace, who picks quirkless Izuku as his successor. Out of costume he's a skinny guy who coughs up blood, which not many people know.

name: Ochaco Uraraka
bio: Izuku's first friend at U.A. who can make anything float by touching it with her fingertips. She wants to be a pro hero to earn money for her parents.

name: Fern
bio: A war orphan raised by Heiter who becomes Frieren's apprentice and travel partner. Quiet and polite, but she will sulk for days if you forget something that matters to her.

name: Stark
bio: Eisen's former pupil, a warrior who is convinced he's a coward even though his hands shake and he fights anyway. Joins Frieren and Fern as their front-liner.

name: Himmel
bio: The hero who led Frieren's old party and defeated the Demon King. He's the reason she sets out on her journey, and he left statues of himself in pretty much every town.

name: Heiter
bio: The priest from the Hero's party, who pretended to be holy while drinking way too much. In his later years he takes in the orphan Fern and asks Frieren to teach her.

name: Sung Jinwoo
bio: Known as the world's weakest hunter until a deadly double dungeon gives him a mysterious System that lets him level up. Now he gets stronger every day, and nobody else can.

name: Cha Hae-In
bio: The vice-guild master of the Hunters Guild and one of Korea's strongest S-rank hunters. She can smell other hunters' mana, which makes most of them unbearable to be around.

name: Igris
bio: A knight in crimson armor who guards the gate of the job-change dungeon and nearly kills Jinwoo. After losing, he becomes one of Jinwoo's most trusted shadow soldiers.

name: Yoo Jinho
bio: The son of a huge construction company's chairman, who becomes Jinwoo's raid partner and self-appointed little brother. Low-rank hunter, massive heart, even bigger wallet.

name: Sung Jinah
bio: Jinwoo's younger sister, a high school student who's studying hard for college and worries about her brother every time he heads into a dungeon.

name: Princess Zelda
bio: Zelda falls through time into the ancient past and meets Hyrule's founders. What she chooses to do there to save Link's future is the biggest gut punch in the whole game.

name: Ganondorf
bio: The Gerudo king who became the Demon King, sealed away under Hyrule Castle for ages. In Tears of the Kingdom he's finally back in the flesh, and he's terrifying.

name: Prince Sidon
bio: The Zora prince who never runs out of enthusiasm. In TotK he becomes the Sage of Water and helps Link clear the gunk out of Zora's Domain.

name: Tulin
bio: Teba's kid, a young Rito who is desperate to prove himself. As the Sage of Wind his gust boosts Link's glides, which makes him the best travel buddy in the game.

name: Mineru
bio: Rauru's sister and the Zonai Sage of Spirit. Her spirit takes over a giant construct in the Depths so she can fight alongside Link one last time.

name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
bio: A demigod cursed with Scarlet Rot who has 'never known defeat.' She waits at the bottom of the Haligtree and is famous for being the hardest boss in the game.

name: Ranni the Witch
bio: A Carian princess who ditched her own body to escape her fate. Her long, cryptic questline leads to the Age of Stars, a fan favorite ending.

name: Melina
bio: The maiden who offers to be your guide, hands you Torrent and turns your runes into levels. She's got a plan of her own for the Erdtree, though.

name: Starscourge Radahn
bio: A demigod general who held the stars in place with gravity magic. Rot ate his mind after his fight with Malenia, so warriors gather for a festival just to put him down.

name: Margit, the Fell Omen
bio: The first real wall most players hit, blocking the road to Stormveil Castle. He hits hard, taunts you nonstop and hides a pretty big secret about who he really is.

name: Godrick the Grafted
bio: The lord of Stormveil Castle who sews other people's limbs onto himself. Halfway through his fight he grafts a dragon's head onto his arm, which is as wild as it sounds.

name: Atreus
bio: Kratos' son, who is also Loki. In Ragnarök he's a teenager chasing prophecy and answers, and you even get to play as him.

name: Freya
bio: The former queen of the Valkyries and Odin's ex-wife. She's out for Kratos' head after the first game, but ends up fighting beside him in Ragnarök.

name: Odin
bio: The Allfather is charming, friendly and completely rotten. He spies on everyone through his ravens and will do anything to stop Ragnarök from happening.

name: Thor
bio: Odin's enforcer and a heavy drinker who has done terrible things for his dad. He hits like a truck with Mjolnir and turns out to be more tragic than you'd expect.

name: Mimir
bio: The smartest man alive, now just a talking head on Kratos' belt. He fills every boat ride with stories and calls Kratos 'brother.'

name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
bio: A sorceress with raven hair, violet eyes and zero patience. She's Geralt's great love and the one who helps him hunt down Ciri.

name: Ciri
bio: Geralt's adopted daughter and the girl the whole plot is chasing. She has Elder Blood, which is why the Wild Hunt wants her so badly.

name: Triss Merigold
bio: A sorceress and old friend of Geralt who's hiding out in Novigrad while witch hunters burn mages. Players still argue about her versus Yennefer.

name: Eredin
bio: The elven king of the Wild Hunt, who rides between worlds and brings the White Frost with him. He wants Ciri's Elder Blood and won't stop until he gets it.

name: Dandelion
bio: A bard, a flirt and Geralt's best friend of many years. He's always getting into trouble in Novigrad, and Geralt is always the one who has to get him out.

name: The Pilot
bio: Fernando Esparza, call sign Echo-216, the pilot who finds Master Chief floating in space. He spends the whole game begging to leave, but he never actually does.

name: The Weapon
bio: An AI made by Dr. Halsey to capture Cortana. She looks just like Cortana but has her own personality, and she ends up as Chief's new partner.

name: Escharum
bio: The Banished War Chief who beat the UNSC on Zeta Halo. He's old and dying, and all he wants is one last proper fight with the Chief.

name: Atriox
bio: The Brute warlord who rebelled against the Covenant and built the Banished. He beat Master Chief before the game even starts, which says a lot.

name: The Harbinger
bio: A mysterious being who works with the Banished while secretly having her own goals. She's trying to free the Endless, an ancient race the Forerunners locked away.

name: Captain Price
bio: The SAS captain with the boonie hat and the mustache. He's been in the series since the first game, and "Bravo Six, going dark" is still one of the coolest lines in gaming.

name: Ghost
bio: Simon Riley, the Task Force 141 soldier in the skull mask. He talks very little and has been one of the most popular characters in the series since MW2.

name: Soap MacTavish
bio: John "Soap" MacTavish, the Scottish SAS rookie you play as in the original Modern Warfare. He goes from new recruit to Price's right-hand man in just a few games.

name: Gaz
bio: Kyle Garrick, the SAS sergeant who fights next to Price. The original Gaz showed up in CoD 4, and the rebooted version got a much bigger role starting with Modern Warfare (2019).

name: Nikolai
bio: A Russian informant turned trusted ally who keeps showing up with a helicopter when Price's team needs a way out.

name: Builderman
bio: The official Roblox account of co-founder David Baszucki. His hard hat avatar has been part of the site since the very beginning.

name: Noob
bio: The classic yellow, blue and green default avatar. Players who never changed it got called noobs, and it turned into Roblox's unofficial mascot.

name: Bacon Hair
bio: Named after the free default hairstyle that looks like a strip of bacon. If you see one in a lobby, they probably just made their account.

name: Guest
bio: The avatar you got when you played without an account, complete with a cap and a ROBLOX shirt. Guests were removed in 2017, but old players still miss them.

name: Robux
bio: The currency that runs Roblox. You spend it on avatar items and game passes, and creators can cash out what they earn through the Developer Exchange.

name: Paimon
bio: The Traveler's floating sidekick and tour guide. She's always hungry, loves treasure, and is 'definitely not emergency food.'

name: Zhongli
bio: A consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who knows way too much about Liyue's history. That's because he's secretly Rex Lapis, the Geo Archon.

name: Raiden Shogun
bio: The Electro Archon who rules Inazuma and chases a never-changing eternity. Her Vision Hunt Decree sets up one of the biggest story arcs in the game.

name: Venti
bio: A bard in Mondstadt who plays the lyre and drinks too much wine. He's actually Barbatos, the Anemo Archon and god of freedom.

name: Hu Tao
bio: The 77th director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, who loves pranks and silly poems. She's also a monster on the battlefield with her Pyro polearm.

name: Alex
bio: Steve's default-skin partner, added in 2014. She can mine, build and fight just like Steve, and she's a big deal to a lot of players.

name: Creeper
bio: The green mob that sneaks up without a sound, hisses and blows up your house. It started as a botched pig model and became the face of Minecraft.

name: Enderman
bio: A tall black mob that wanders around moving blocks. Look it in the eyes and it'll teleport right next to you, and it really hates water.

name: Ender Dragon
bio: The final boss waiting in the End, healing off crystals on obsidian pillars. Beating her rolls the credits and the famous End Poem.

name: Warden
bio: A blind monster from the Deep Dark that tracks you by sound and vibration. It has more health than the Ender Dragon, so sneaking past is usually the smart move.

name: Jonesy
bio: The guy you probably dropped in as on your very first match. Jonesy has had a ton of versions since, and one of them even knows the island's big secrets.

name: Peely
bio: A walking banana with a big smile that showed up in the Season 8 Battle Pass. Nobody expected a banana to become one of Fortnite's most famous characters.

name: Fishstick
bio: A guy in a goofy fish suit (or maybe an actual fish) with a big grin. He's been around since 2018 and has shown up in a ridiculous number of versions.

name: Midas
bio: The boss of the Agency from Chapter 2 Season 2, and everything he touches turns to gold. His Doomsday Device plan backfired and ended up flooding the whole island.

name: Drift
bio: The Season 5 Battle Pass star with the fox mask and hoodie. His look got more upgraded the more you played, which was a big deal back then.

name: Stilgar
bio: The Fremen leader of Sietch Tabr and Paul's biggest believer. Javier Bardem plays him with so much faith in the prophecy that he's honestly the funniest part of Part Two.

name: Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen
bio: The Baron's psychotic younger nephew, raised on Giedi Prime and bred to rule. Austin Butler plays him bald, pale and terrifying, all the way to his duel with Paul.

name: Baron Vladimir Harkonnen
bio: Head of House Harkonnen and the man behind the attack on the Atreides. Stellan Skarsgård floats through every scene looking like pure menace.

name: Lady Jessica
bio: Paul's mother, a Bene Gesserit who drinks the Water of Life and becomes a Reverend Mother. Rebecca Ferguson makes her one of the scariest people on Arrakis this time.

name: Miguel O'Hara
bio: Spider-Man 2099 and the leader of the Spider-Society, obsessed with protecting canon events at any cost. Voiced by Oscar Isaac, and yes, that chase scene is all him.

name: Peter B. Parker
bio: The tired, older Spider-Man from the first film, now a proud dad carrying baby Mayday everywhere he goes. Jake Johnson voices him again.

name: Hobie Brown
bio: Spider-Punk from Earth-138, an anti-establishment rebel with a guitar and a mohawk. Daniel Kaluuya voices him, and he steals pretty much every scene he's in.

name: Pavitr Prabhakar
bio: Spider-Man India, protector of the city of Mumbattan. Karan Soni voices him as the most cheerful and chaotic member of the crew.

name: The Spot
bio: Jonathan Ohnn, a former Alchemax scientist whose body is covered in portals after the accident from the first film. Voiced by Jason Schwartzman, he starts as a joke and gets scary fast.

name: Doctor Doom
bio: Victor von Doom, the armored ruler of Latveria and the big threat of the next Avengers film. Robert Downey Jr. returns to Marvel to play him, which still feels wild to say.

name: Thor
bio: The God of Thunder is back for another team-up, with Chris Hemsworth returning in the role after Love and Thunder. He's one of the few original Avengers confirmed so far.

name: Loki
bio: After taking his place at the end of time to hold the multiverse together, Loki is confirmed to return. Tom Hiddleston is back as the God of Mischief.

name: Sam Wilson
bio: The former Falcon who now carries the shield as Captain America. Anthony Mackie returns to lead the Avengers after Captain America: Brave New World.

name: Reed Richards
bio: Mister Fantastic, the stretchy genius who leads the Fantastic Four. Pedro Pascal brings him over from The Fantastic Four: First Steps.

name: Sue Storm
bio: The Invisible Woman, who can turn invisible and create force fields. Vanessa Kirby returns after The Fantastic Four: First Steps.

name: Steve Rogers
bio: Captain America himself, who leads the Time Heist and finally lifts Mjolnir in the final battle. Chris Evans gives him the ending fans had wanted for years.

name: Thor
bio: Five years after failing to stop the Snap, Thor is hiding out in New Asgard playing video games. Chris Hemsworth makes "Bro Thor" both hilarious and sad.

name: Natasha Romanoff
bio: Black Widow keeps the Avengers going after the Snap, then gives her life on Vormir for the Soul Stone. Played by Scarlett Johansson.

name: Bruce Banner
bio: Now merged with the Hulk into "Smart Hulk," Bruce is the one who wears the new gauntlet and brings everyone back. Mark Ruffalo plays him.

name: Thanos
bio: The Mad Titan, whose 2014 self travels forward in time to finish what he started. Josh Brolin plays him, and "I am inevitable" is still a great line.

name: Murph Cooper
bio: Cooper's stubborn, brilliant daughter who grows up to solve the gravity equation. Played by Mackenzie Foy as a kid and Jessica Chastain as an adult.

name: Amelia Brand
bio: A NASA biologist on the Endurance crew and Professor Brand's daughter. Anne Hathaway plays her, including that famous speech about love.

name: Professor Brand
bio: The NASA physicist who recruits Cooper and plans the whole mission, while hiding a huge secret about Plan A. Played by Michael Caine.

name: Dr. Mann
bio: The celebrated scientist the crew finds on the ice planet, who is not what he seems. Matt Damon plays him in one of the film's best surprises.

name: Morpheus
bio: Captain of the Nebuchadnezzar who offers Neo the red pill and truly believes he's The One. Laurence Fishburne makes every line sound legendary.

name: Trinity
bio: A top hacker and fighter on Morpheus's crew who opens the film with that iconic rooftop escape. Played by Carrie-Anne Moss.

name: Agent Smith
bio: A program built to hunt down rebels inside the Matrix, and he really hates humans. Hugo Weaving's "Mr. Anderson" is one of the most quoted lines ever.

name: Cypher
bio: A crew member who is tired of the real world and makes a deal with the Agents to go back into the Matrix. Played by Joe Pantoliano.

name: The Oracle
bio: A kind woman who bakes cookies and tells the future, or at least tells people what they need to hear. Played by Gloria Foster in the original film.

name: Gale Hawthorne
bio: Katniss's hunting partner and best friend from District 12, who becomes a soldier in the rebellion. Played by Liam Hemsworth.

name: Haymitch Abernathy
bio: District 12's only living Victor and Katniss and Peeta's grumpy, usually drunk mentor. Woody Harrelson plays him perfectly.

name: President Snow
bio: The ruthless president of Panem, who keeps the districts in line with fear and white roses. Donald Sutherland plays him in the main films.

name: Effie Trinket
bio: The Capitol escort for District 12, known for her wild outfits and "May the odds be ever in your favor." Elizabeth Banks plays her.

name: Jin
bio: BTS's eldest member and one of its vocalists. His solo single "The Astronaut" came out in 2022, co-written with Coldplay.

name: Suga
bio: Lead rapper and producer of BTS from Daegu. He also releases music as Agust D, including the 2023 album D-Day.

name: j-hope
bio: BTS's main dancer and a rapper from Gwangju. In 2022 he became the first South Korean artist to headline a main stage at Lollapalooza.

name: V
bio: Known for his deep, low voice, V is a vocalist in BTS. His first solo album, Layover, was released in 2023.

name: Jisoo
bio: BLACKPINK's eldest member and lead vocalist. Her 2023 solo single "Flower" was a hit, and she starred in the drama Snowdrop.

name: Bang Chan
bio: Leader of Stray Kids, raised in Sydney, Australia. He produces much of the group's music as part of the in-house team 3RACHA.

name: Lee Know
bio: Stray Kids' main dancer and a vocalist. Before joining the group, he worked as a backup dancer for BTS.

name: Changbin
bio: Main rapper of Stray Kids and a member of 3RACHA, the trio that writes and produces most of the group's songs.

name: Hyunjin
bio: A main dancer and visual in Stray Kids, known for his expressive stage presence. He also paints and shares his artwork with fans.

name: Han
bio: Han raps and sings for Stray Kids and co-writes as part of 3RACHA. He spent part of his childhood in Malaysia.

name: Felix
bio: Stray Kids' lead dancer, born and raised in Sydney, Australia. Fans know him for his very deep speaking and rapping voice.

name: Nayeon
bio: TWICE's lead vocalist and eldest member. In 2022 she became the first TWICE member to debut solo, with the single "Pop!".

name: Jihyo
bio: Leader and main vocalist of TWICE, who trained at JYP for about ten years before debut. She released the solo single "Killin' Me Good" in 2023.

name: Momo
bio: TWICE's main dancer, from Kyoto, Japan. She is also part of the Japanese subunit MISAMO with Sana and Mina.

name: Sana
bio: A vocalist in TWICE from Osaka, Japan. She's a member of the MISAMO subunit and a favorite on variety shows.

name: Tzuyu
bio: TWICE's youngest member, from Tainan, Taiwan. She released her first solo album, abouTZU, in 2024 with the single "Run Away".

name: Dahyun
bio: Dahyun is TWICE's lead rapper and also plays piano. Fans still bring up the "eagle dance" she did on the survival show Sixteen.

name: S.Coups
bio: Leader of SEVENTEEN and head of its hip-hop unit, from Daegu. In 2025 he and Mingyu released the duo album Hype Vibes.

name: Jeonghan
bio: A lead vocalist in SEVENTEEN's vocal unit, known among fans for his long hair era and his playful pranks on the members.

name: Hoshi
bio: Leader of SEVENTEEN's performance unit, he helps choreograph the group's dances. His tiger nickname is a fan favorite.

name: Woozi
bio: SEVENTEEN's vocal unit leader and main producer. He has written and produced most of the group's songs since debut.

name: Mingyu
bio: A rapper in SEVENTEEN's hip-hop unit, known as one of the group's visuals and its go-to cook in the dorm.

name: Seungkwan
bio: Main vocalist of SEVENTEEN from Jeju Island. He's also in the subunit BSS with DK and Hoshi and a natural on variety shows.

name: Hongjoong
bio: Leader and main rapper of ATEEZ. He takes part in writing and producing many of the group's songs.

name: Seonghwa
bio: ATEEZ's eldest member, a lead dancer and vocalist. Fans often call him the group's caretaker.

name: San
bio: San is a main dancer and lead vocalist of ATEEZ, known for intense facial expressions and energy on stage.

name: Wooyoung
bio: A main dancer and lead vocalist in ATEEZ. Along with San, he's one of the group's loudest mood makers on and off stage.

name: Jongho
bio: ATEEZ's main vocalist and youngest member, famous for his high notes and for breaking apples with his bare hands.

name: Mingi
bio: Main rapper of ATEEZ with a distinctive low voice. He has co-written lyrics for several of the group's songs.
